neighbours.label: The last word before an expected 'as well', 'too' or 'also', after a frame that sets up an addition ('not only by peers but by staff', 'We hope yours was Wonderful', 'helps in other ways'); the same word with no addition expected stays low.
fire: The rules bind not only the players but the coaches.
She is known not just for her songs but for her paintings.
It was a lovely Sunday! We hope yours was lovely.
The law harms farmers in other ways.
He teaches not only at the college but at the prison.
We had a great Friday! I hope you had a great Friday.
Besides the pool, the hotel has a gym.
Doctors treat not only the old but the young.
quiet: The rules bind the players and the coaches.
She is known for her songs and her paintings.
It was a lovely Sunday! The weather was lovely.
The law harms farmers in three ways.
He teaches at the college near the prison.
We had a great Friday! The food was great.
The storm hurt the town in many ways.
Doctors treat the old and the young.

short: word before an expected 'as well' or 'too'
notes: Probes: 0.44-0.56 for 'not only ... but' and 'hope yours was'; 'in other ways' 0.54; ' year' 0.20, ' stuff' 0.16, ' them' 0.07. The same words with no addition 0.00-0.05. The output direction promotes ' as', ' too'.
